hook_text: 7 pizzas, 4 hungry friends. How much does each get? Is it 4/7?
clip_script: 7 pizzas, 4 friends. Is it 4/7 each? That is less than one pizza, but there are more pizzas than friends! Share it out: 1 whole each, then cut the last 3 into quarters. 3 quarters more each. 1 and 3/4 pizzas! Things on top, people underneath: 7/4. Now a farmer near Graaff-Reinet: 3/4 of 240 sheep are white. Bottom divides: 240 divided by 4 is 60. Top multiplies: 3 times 60 is 180. Bottom divides, top multiplies.
visual_style: Pizzas sliding to four plates, then three pizzas slicing into quarters, then a flock of sheep splitting into four equal groups.
mood: Friendly and fair, like sharing at a braai.
pacing: Trap question, a fair share-out, then a quick fraction of a flock.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and work out the sale price of a R450 jacket with 1/5 off.
